summary: An anchored panel that holds interactive content. Sits between Tooltip and Modal.
useWhen: the content is interactive — a form, a filter, a list of actions — but should stay attached to the control that opened it
the surrounding page should stay visible and in context

useInstead.when: the content is a short hint with nothing focusable in it
useInstead.why: a tooltip cannot be focused or scrolled and closes when the pointer leaves

useInstead.when: the task takes over the page or must be completed before anything else
you only need the list surface and will position it yourself

bottom.use: below the trigger — the usual choice for a control in a header

left.use: to the left of the trigger

right.use: to the right of the trigger

sm.use: a couple of actions or one short field

lg.use: a small form or a filter panel

children.note: the trigger. Must forward both a ref and DOM props — every component in this library does

title.note: also gives the dialog its accessible name

guarantees: focus is contained while open, Escape and outside clicks close it, and the rest of the page is hidden from assistive tech
`placement` is a preference, not a guarantee — it flips when there is no room, and the arrow follows
requires: `title`, or `aria-label` on the popover — a dialog with no name announces nothing about what opened
notes: `placement` names where the POPOVER sits, not where the arrow points.

antiPatterns.dont: a function-component trigger that drops its ref
antiPatterns.why: it renders, but the popover has nothing to position against

antiPatterns.dont: using a Popover where a Modal belongs
antiPatterns.why: a popover closes on an outside click; a task that must be finished should not be dismissible by a stray click

antiPatterns.dont: nesting a Popover inside another Popover
antiPatterns.why: two overlapping focus containments, and dismissing the outer one takes the inner one with it
